target: Gold London Fixing, USD per troy ounce

backtest_notional.note: Research normalization only; not an actual account balance or position.

strategies.name: 策略1
strategies.rule: weight = clip(0.10 / annualized_volatility_20d, 0.25, 0.75) when gold > MA200 and annualized_volatility_20d < 0.22, otherwise 0

strategies.name: 策略2
strategies.rule: weight = clip(0.12 / annualized_volatility_20d, 0.25, 1.00) only when gold > MA150 and all three votes are favorable: DXY_60d_return < 0, US_10y_real_yield_60d_change < 0, VIX_20d_return <= 0.15; otherwise 0

strategies.name: 策略3
strategies.rule: weight = clip(0.12 / annualized_volatility_20d, 0.25, 1.00) when gold > MA150 and DXY_60d_return < 0, otherwise 0

replacement_policy: Do not replace without a frozen scoring rule and an out-of-sample comparison.
